response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) as count_per_side
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_per_side) as overall_avg
  FROM matched
)
SELECT 
  SUM(m.count_per_side) as total_count,
  AVG(m.count_per_side - ac.overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM matched m
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE m.count_per_side > ac.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The total count per side is the sum of all risk/margin records (not distinct orders) grouped by dealedge, clarified by 'an order with two risk/margin records counts twice'
Average excess is the arithmetic mean of (count − overall_average) computed across only the dealedges whose count exceeds the overall average
